analyzed: pāka ja rūpa ādi vat timitta janya tvam tat eva bandhe pratiṣidhyate puruṣe bandhasya aupādhika tva abhyupagamāt nanu kāla ādi nimittaka tve pi sahakāri antara sambhava asambhavābhyām vyavasthā syāt iti ced evam sati yad saṃyoge sati avaśyam bandhaḥ tatra eva sahakāriṇi lāghavāt bandhaḥ yuktaḥ puruṣe bandha vyavahārasya aupādhika tvena api upapatteḥ iti kṛtam naimittika tvena iti

original: saṅghātaviśeṣarūpatākhyā deharūpā yā'vasthā tannimittato'pi puruṣasya bandhaḥ| kutaḥ? tasyā avasthāyā dehadharmatvāt | acetanadharmatvādityarthaḥ. anyadarmasya sākṣādanyabandhakatve'tiprasaṅgānmuktasyāpi bandhāpatterityarthaḥ|| 14 ||

original: iti -- śabdo hetvarthe| puruṣasyāsaṅaagatvādavasthāyā dehamātradharmatvamiti pūrvasūtreṇānvayaḥ| puruṣasyāvasthārūpavikārasvīkāre | vakārahetusaṃyogākhyaḥ saṅgaḥ prasajjyeteti bhāvaḥ| asaṅgatve ca śrutiḥ -- 'sa yadatra kiñcit paśyatyananvāgatastena bhavati' |
analyzed: iti śabdaḥ hetu arthe puruṣasya asaṅaaga tvāt avasthāyāḥ deha mātra dharma tvam iti pūrva sūtreṇa anvayaḥ puruṣasya avasthā rūpa vikāra svīkāre vakāra hetu saṃyoga ākhyaḥ saṅgaḥ prasajjyeta iti bhāvaḥ asaṅga tve ca śrutiḥ sa yat atra kiñcid paśyati an anvāgataḥ tena bhavati

original: asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣa iti saṅgaśca saṃyogamātraṃ na bhavati, kāladeśasambandhasya pūrvamuktatvāt| śrutismṛtiṣu padmapattrasthajalaneva padmapatrasyāṅgatāyāḥ puruṣāsaṅgatāyāṃ dṛṣṭāntatāśravaṇācca
analyzed: asaṅgaḥ hi ayam puruṣaḥ iti saṅgaḥ ca saṃyoga mātram na bhavati kāla deśa sambandhasya pūrvam ukta tvāt śruti smṛtiṣu padma pattra stha jalanā iva padma patrasya aṅga tāyāḥ puruṣa asaṅga tāyām dṛṣṭānta tā śravaṇāt ca

original: na hi vihitaniṣiddhakarmaṇāpi puruṣasya bandhaḥ| karmaṇāmanātmadharmatvat| anyadharmeṇa sākṣādanyasya bandhe ca muktasyāpi bandhāpatteḥ| nanu svasvopādhikarmaṇā bandhāṅgīkāre nāyaṃ doṣa ityāśayena hetvantaramāha| atiprasakteśceti || pralayādāvapi duḥkhayogarūpabandhāpatteścetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: na hi vihita niṣiddha karmaṇā api puruṣasya bandhaḥ karmaṇām anātma dharma tvat anya dharmeṇa sākṣāt anyasya bandhe ca muktasya api bandha āpatteḥ nanu sva sva upādhi karmaṇā bandha aṅgīkāre na ayam doṣaḥ iti āśayena hetu antaram āha ati prasakteḥ ca iti pralaya ādau api duḥkha yoga rūpa bandha āpatteḥ ca iti arthaḥ

original: sahakāryyantaravilambato vilambakalpanaṃ ca prāgeva nirākṛtaṃ , na kālayoga ityādisūtra iti || 16 ||

original: nanvevaṃduḥkhayogarūpo'pi bandhaḥ karmasāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhena cittasyaivāstu, duḥkhasya cittadharmatāyāḥ siddhatvāt, kimarthaṃ puruṣasyāpi kalpate ityāśaṅkāyāmāha --

vicitra bhoga anupapattiḥ anya dharma tve

original: duḥkhayogarūpabandhasya cittamātradharmatve vicitrabogānupapattiḥ| puruṣasya hi duḥkhayogaṃ vināpi duḥkhasākṣātkārākhyabhogasvīkāre sarvapuruṣaduḥkhādīnāṃ sarvapuruṣabhogyatā syānniyāmakābhāvāt | tataścāyaṃ duḥkhabhoktā'yāṃ ca sukhabhoktetyādirūpabhogavaicitryaṃ nopapadyatetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: duḥkha yoga rūpa bandhasya cittamātra dharma tve vicitra boga anupapattiḥ puruṣasya hi duḥkha yogam vinā api duḥkha sākṣātkāra ākhya bhoga svīkāre sarva puruṣa duḥkha ādīnām sarva puruṣa bhogyatā syāt niyāmaka abhāvāt tatas ca ayam duḥkha bhoktāyām ca sukha bhoktā ityādi rūpa bhoga vaicitryam na upapadyate iti arthaḥ

original: ato bhogavaicitryopapattaye bhoganiyāmakatayā duḥkhādiyogarūpo bandhaḥ puruṣe'pi svīkāryaḥ| sa ca papuruṣe duḥkhayogaḥ pratibimbarūpa eveti prāgevoktam| pratibimbaśca svopādhivṛttereva na sarvapuṃsā sarvaduḥkhabhoga iti yogabhāṣyādayaṃ siddhāntaḥ siddhaḥ| citte ca puruṣasya svatvaṃ svabhuktavṛttivāsanāvattvamiti |
analyzed: atas bhoga vaicitrya upapattaye bhoga niyāmaka tayā duḥkha ādi yoga rūpaḥ bandhaḥ puruṣe api svīkāryaḥ sa ca duḥkha yogaḥ pratibimba rūpaḥ eva iti prāk eva uktam pratibimbaḥ ca sva upādhi vṛtteḥ eva na sarva puṃsā sarva duḥkha bhogaḥ iti yoga bhāṣyāt ayam siddhāntaḥ siddhaḥ citte ca puruṣasya svatvam sva bhukta vṛtti vāsanāvat tvam iti

original: ya.ttu cittasyaiva bandhamokṣo, na puruṣasyeti śrutismṛtiṣu gīyate, tad bimbarūpaduḥkhayogarūpaṃ pāramārthikaṃ bandhamādāya bodhyam||17||

analyzed: tasmāt tad yogāt ṛte prakṛti saṃyogam vinā na puruṣasya tad yogaḥ bandha samparkaḥ asti api tu saḥ eva bandhaḥ bandhasya aupādhika tva lābhāya nañ dvayena vakroktiḥ yadi hi bandhaḥ prakṛti saṃyoga janyaḥ syāt pāka ja rūpa vat tadā tadvat eva tad viyoge api anuvartteta na ca dvitīya kṣaṇa ādeḥ duḥkha nāśaka tvam kalpyam
